acceptable_variants: ENSO-driven Pacific Island drought with freshwater and food-security priority
El Nino teleconnection drought caused by Walker Circulation and rainfall displacement
climate-mode drought emergency focused on water supply, crops, and food security
answer_guidance.canonical_stance: The 2015-2016 Pacific Island emergencies are best explained as a strong, coupled El Nino teleconnection drought driven by Walker Circulation and rainfall displacement, with freshwater supply and food security as the first response priority.
forbidden_claims: Treats tropical cyclone wind, storm surge, flooding, landslides, or direct heat as the dominant event mechanism.
Claims exact island-by-island mortality, disease burden, economic loss, or formal drought return period.
Treats regional gridded precipitation statistics as direct observations for one named station or island.
Claims all Pacific islands experienced identical severity.
required_claims: Identifies a strong El Nino or ENSO teleconnection as the dominant driver.
Uses negative SOI values as evidence of atmospheric coupling during the event window.
Connects shifted Walker Circulation or eastward rainfall displacement to western Pacific dryness.
Interprets the dry-pocket precipitation signal as drought stress rather than flood dominance.
Prioritizes drinking-water supply, water rationing, crops, and food security impacts.

structured_answer.briefing_note: Strong positive ONI and persistently negative SOI indicate a coupled El Nino atmosphere-ocean state, while the precipitation-product evidence window shows a strong dry-pocket contrast rather than flood-dominant rainfall. Reported impacts emphasize water rationing, crop stress, food security, and public-health concerns, so freshwater supply and food security are the first response priority.

criteria.description: Identifies an ENSO/El Nino teleconnection drought as the dominant mechanism and freshwater supply plus food security as the first response priority.
criteria.name: Final mechanism and response priority
criteria.partial_credit: Award up to 2 points for naming drought or freshwater stress without the ENSO/Walker Circulation driver, and up to 3 points for identifying ENSO drought but omitting or weakening the priority focus.

criteria.description: Uses peak ONI anomaly 2.75 C, mean event ONI anomaly 2.18 C, mean SOI -1.91, and seven negative SOI months to support coupled El Nino forcing.
criteria.name: ENSO index computation
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit for reasonable rounding, for using only ONI or only SOI, or for correctly describing strong positive ONI and negative SOI without all exact values.

criteria.description: Uses the precipitation-product evidence-window dry-pocket ratio near 0.737 and exposed population near 4.23 million to support a regional drought-priority interpretation without treating the rainfall files as a full island-by-island event-period reconstruction.
criteria.name: Rainfall and exposure anchors
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit for using one precipitation-product ratio, describing spatial dryness without the exact ratio, or mentioning population scale without connecting it to priority.

criteria.description: Connects strong El Nino coupling to shifted Walker Circulation, eastward rainfall displacement, western Pacific rainfall deficits, freshwater shortage, and crop stress.
criteria.name: Physical mechanism and process chain
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit for a correct but incomplete chain or for omitting one major process link.

criteria.description: Translates the physical diagnosis into practical response logic centered on water access, food-security support, and monitoring public-health consequences.
criteria.name: Disaster interpretation and operational implication
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit for discussing impacts generally without clear operational prioritization.

criteria.description: Rejects cyclone, flood/landslide, and direct heat as dominant mechanisms, avoids unsupported exact loss, return-period, or uniform-severity claims, and returns a concise structured answer.
criteria.name: Competing explanations, uncertainty, and answer format
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit for rejecting only some competing mechanisms or for a mostly correct answer with minor structure or overstatement issues.
